title: What his best trading students have in common
caption: Tradever's CEO on the one trait he sees in his most successful students. #tradever #propfirm #daytrading #futurestrading #ad @tradeverfunding @laythbanks

slides.text: His best students have *one thing* in common.
They are not scared to lose.
slides.sub: On what he sees in his students

slides.text: If you're coming in and you're already scared to lose and you got a scarcity mindset … you start to go downward in a downward spiral.
Onto the next, it's okay, no problem. We'll make it back on the next one.
